card.name: Words before praised or defining nouns
card.fires_on: Small words such as first, grand, a, that, true or with, placed just before a noun in elevated, literary or historical prose. They set up a description of a notable person, thing or place.

modes.description: A, that or with opening a noun phrase of praise or characterization.
